# PLACEHOLDER: there is no key here yet, so no private record is collected.
#
# This file holds the PUBLIC age key(s) that the private record of the evaluation of main (what a parser
# did on a generated file: see .github/workflows/evaluate-main.yml) is encrypted to. Only the one with the
# private key can read the record; the public key is safe to commit. Add one key per line.
#
# To set it up, once, on your own machine (the private key never leaves it, and never goes in this repository):
#
#     age-keygen -o fanbase-incidents.key       # writes the private key; prints "Public key: age1..."
#     age-keygen -y fanbase-incidents.key       # prints the public key again
#
# Then replace everything in this file with that one line (it begins with age1). Lines that start with
# # and empty lines are ignored.
